name: reader-plugin
description: A private, local-first TXT and EPUB novel reader with an embedded bookshelf and durable reading progress.

interface.shortDescription: 安静读书，接着上次的位置。
interface.longDescription: A focused Chinese-language novel reader for MCP Apps hosts. Import DRM-free TXT and EPUB books, browse chapters, save bookmarks, and customize typography. Host sidebar and panel compatibility requires client validation.
